note: Problems met by users (error log) and how they were solved. Updated by the developer with each fix, in the same pull request. Statuses: open, fixing, fixed, no_action. 'match' links a registry entry to the error log (code, and place when given).

problems.title: App closed when showing lab test names with "(%)"
problems.cause: t() always formatted the text, so the literal % in "Neutrophils (%)" threw UnknownFormatConversionException
problems.fix: Format only when arguments are passed; the server keeps crash:<ExceptionClass> instead of "unknown"

problems.title: Expired session asked to sign in again
problems.cause: Expected behaviour after the session expired; not repeated

problems.title: After the terms update, an older app said "Something went wrong" when accepting
problems.cause: The server requires terms v17; an older app shows and sends v16, got 400 bad_version and showed a generic error
problems.fix: An older terms version gets 426 app_disabled: the old app shows its "install the latest version" screen with the download link

problems.title: Nightly vulnerability scan could not list the app's libraries
problems.cause: The release-signing guard in android/app/build.gradle.kts matched every command argument containing "Release", including "--configuration releaseRuntimeClasspath" used by the scan, and stopped it for the missing key
problems.fix: The guard now applies only to tasks that build a release package (assemble/bundle/package/sign …Release); the scan runs without secrets again

problems.title: The Dashboard icon downloaded a file instead of opening the dashboard
problems.cause: Reported by the owner on his phone. The app opened the dashboard address with a plain view intent, so any app registered for links of that site (most likely the download manager used to install the APK) could take it instead of the browser
problems.fix: The dashboard, the owner area and the data-access link open in the phone's browser, chosen by package (openInBrowser in Report.kt); the icon is renamed Reports

problems.title: Reports, Owner and the full-reports button opened the browser without the dashboard
problems.cause: Reported by the owner on his phone. The P-005 fix used a browser selector intent, which starts the browser's main screen and drops the address
problems.fix: openInBrowser now passes the address to the browser itself: the phone's default browser, else Chrome, else the first browser found (manifest <queries> lists browsers); failures go to the error log (Web/browser)

problems.title: Release 0.1.118 stopped after a correct deploy: the /download check ran too early
problems.cause: The build checks that /download serves the new APK 5 seconds after the deploy; the edge still served 0.1.117 for a few seconds, so the job failed and the release was not recorded
problems.fix: The check now tries again every 10 seconds for up to 2 minutes before failing

problems.title: Bouncy Castle 1.72 with known advisories inside the app (via pdfbox-android)
problems.cause: pdfbox-android 2.0.27.0 depends on bcprov/bcpkix-jdk15to18 1.72; the nightly scan listed 12 advisories (2 Critical) and the owner asked a fix from the Security console (#126); the automatic Security fix run stopped before doing it
problems.fix: A Gradle constraint raises bcprov, bcpkix and bcutil (jdk15to18) to 1.86, same API; build and tests in CI

problems.title: The Scan without AI said «not clear» on a sharp photo of a real monitor (Medisana)
problems.cause: The on-phone seven-segment reader (MonitorReader) and the ML Kit fallback were tuned on generated photos; on real displays they read 0 of 7 photos, so they asked for a retake even on clear photos
problems.fix: Decision of Human: the Scan now uses the person's own AI subscription (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Kimi) with a key kept encrypted on the phone; off until unlocked; terms v21
